MINI PRD
Version 0.1

Requirement conventions: FR-DOMAIN-NNN and NFR-NNN. Identifiers are permanent.

9 Accounts
ID Requirement Pri
FR-ACC-001 A visitor must be able to create an account with an email address and a
password.
WHEN a visitor submits valid registration data
THE SYSTEM SHALL create an account.
P0
FR-ACC-002 An email address must be verified by a single-use, time-limited link before
the account may transact.
IF a verification link is used twice
THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it.
P0
FR-ACC-003 A person must be able to reset a forgotten password. Completing a reset must
invalidate all existing sessions.
P0
FR-ACC-004 Sessions must expire after a defined period of inactivity.
P1

10 Billing
ID Requirement Pri
FR-BIL-001 Checkout must create an Order with immutable line items before payment is
attempted.
P0
FR-BIL-002 On successful payment the platform must, in one atomic outcome: create the
subscription, write the ledger entries, and send the receipt.
P0
FR-BIL-003 Refunds must reverse the ledger entries that the original payment wrote.
P0
FR-BIL-004 A buyer must see their purchase history with receipts. This should be easy
and user-friendly.
P1

11 Notifications
ID Requirement Pri
FR-NOT-001 All notifications must be issued through a single notification service.
P0
FR-NOT-002 Every notification must be recorded per recipient with its delivery state.
P0

27 Non-functional
ID Requirement Pri
NFR-001 All traffic must use current transport encryption.
P0
NFR-002 Pages must render within 2.5 seconds at the 75th percentile.
P0
